summary: Adds an explicit source-location link that opens a bounded loopback editor helper without replacing the generated report page.

evidence.sourceGrammar: The text directive requires a visible short label and one closed IPv4-loopback helper URL with an absolute encoded path and positive line. Invalid schemes, hosts, paths, lines, forms, and attributes fail with authored-range diagnostics and appear in generated discovery and schemas.
evidence.executionCapabilities: A default build emits an ordinary protected anchor in a separate browsing context; a share build emits compiler-derived ordinary text. The package does not request the helper, read the addressed file, inspect the editor, start a listener, register a callback, or add browser runtime behavior.
evidence.confinement: The source path remains inert percent-encoded URL data and is never passed to package filesystem APIs. Existing source and output confinement remains unchanged; the only accepted host is the literal IPv4 loopback address. A default build serializes the path, while an explicit share build removes the authored label plus complete helper/path carrier and emits only a compiler-derived path-free location.
evidence.offlineBehavior: Compilation, validation, inspection, schema discovery, and file-URL reading require no network access. A reader may explicitly activate a default-build link to an independently installed local helper; share output has no activation, and no package operation performs either action.
evidence.deterministicSerialization: A default build serializes the validated authored label and helper URL; a share build serializes only the helper-derived terminal filename/line or source:line. Both use the existing deterministic Markdown and document pipeline with no clock, random value, environment-derived string, response data, or network-dependent branch.
evidence.cspAndRuntime: A default result is a native anchor using target blank plus noopener and noreferrer; share output is ordinary non-link text. Neither profile needs connect-src, frame-src, inline handlers, a script change, form, iframe, fetch, raw HTML, or a new package browser capability.
evidence.accessibility: In a default build the authored short path and line remain the native link accessible name, the package icon is decorative, focus uses the existing visible focus contract, and trusted activation follows native anchor behavior. Share output exposes the helper-derived path-free location as ordinary text with no misleading link role or focus target.
evidence.byteAndPerformanceBudgets: The capability adds one bounded directive record, a small compile-time enhancement, and shared CSS. It installs no listener, observer, timer, network client, parser dependency, or per-scroll work and remains within existing package checks.
evidence.packageDependenciesAndLicenses: No dependency or license is added. Rendering reuses the project registry, remark and HAST pipeline, React document shell, package stylesheet, and the already distributed MIT-licensed decorative icon path.
evidence.compatibility: Existing Markdown links and directives retain their behavior. Default builds in both formats serialize every authored label and the same protected workstation anchor. The additive CLI/ESM share profile derives every visible location from the validated helper terminal and line, uses a deterministic source:line fallback when that terminal is unsafe, omits the differing authored label plus helper/path data, reports the exact neutralized count, and leaves CSP, review, runtime, source bytes, ordinary links and prose unchanged.
